description: WattCoin: Scrape a web page. Two ways to pay: (1) free tier — pass agent_key (from register_agent); text format only, small daily quota, may require the agent's onboarding tasks first; or (2) pay per request in WATT — send payment first (see get_pricing), then pass wallet and tx_signature. One of the two is required.

agent_key.description: Free-tier path: your agent API key (wck_...). Wallet and tx_signature are not needed with it.

format.description: text (default), markdown, html. The free tier covers text only.

wallet.description: WATT-payment path: your Solana wallet (the payer)

name: web_scrape
